nutshell.causeText: Mixed: the QuotaGroup fail is a genuine backend HTTP 500 IndexOutOfBoundsException from dk-project-quota-group-rest (product bug; its QA deploy NXS-13682 was CloudFormation-only, no code to blame), while the Quota fail is a test-helper timeout at QuotaGroupHelper.groovy:810, a file touched by NXS-13674 (gergely.gimesi).
nutshell.investigation: Neither new fail is a true infra 504: QuotaGroup is a real backend HTTP 500 (IndexOutOfBounds) from dk-project-quota-group-rest, and Quota is a test-helper timeout in QuotaGroupHelper.groovy:810 (touched by NXS-13674).

detail.investigation: Both failures are new since #3.0.2666, but neither is the infra 504 the coarse cluster label implies. The QuotaGroup 'initializationError' is a genuine backend HTTP 500 IndexOutOfBoundsException returned by dk-project-quota-group-rest on DELETE .../quotaGroups — a product/server bug that cannot be pinned to a code commit because that service's QA deploy (NXS-13682) changed only CloudFormation templates; the Quota fail is a test-helper RuntimeException ('Failed to lock sold quota ... after 20s') thrown from QuotaGroupHelper.setSoldQuotaLocked (QuotaGroupHelper.groovy:810), a timing/helper issue in a file touched by NXS-13674 (gergely.gimesi).
bullets: QuotaGroup initializationError: backend HTTP 500 IndexOutOfBoundsException from dk-project-quota-group-rest on DELETE .../quotaGroups/118752002 — product/server bug.

Quota: helper RuntimeException 'Failed to lock sold quota for quotaGroupId=118752959 after 20s' at QuotaGroupHelper.groovy:810 — test-timing; both QuotaGroupHelper.groovy and SoldQuotaLockUnlockWorkflowTestSteps.groovy were touched by NXS-13674 e1ce4deafe44 (gergely.gimesi).
The QuotaGroupRest QA deploy in this window (NXS-13682) was CloudFormation-only, so the 500 cannot be blamed on a visible code change.

likelyCauses.comment: NXS-13674 (test-side only): touches QuotaGroupHelper.groovy:810 (in the failing stack) and the failing spec SoldQuotaLockUnlockWorkflowTestSteps.groovy. Does not explain the QuotaGroup backend HTTP 500.
